note: Elliott County KY (21063) parcels are not published as a queryable ArcGIS/WFS/OGC service. The state kygisserver directory has only the Webster County PVA parcel service (Ky_PVA_Webster_Parcels_WGS84WM); no Elliott service exists in the WGS84WM_Services folder. The Elliott PVA points to a Schneider qPublic viewer (no public REST endpoint) and tells users to request bulk data from the PVA office. Commercial vendors (Rockford Map, acres) sell parcel shapefiles but are not a public service.
